en: what is ongoing purchase order
where to see open pos

a.en: Ongoing Purchase Order shows every PO with status Ordered or In transit, line by line, with pending quantity, delivery date and when to follow up next.
a.hi: Ongoing Purchase Order में Ordered या In transit वाले हर PO की लाइनें दिखती हैं — बाकी मात्रा, डिलीवरी तारीख और अगला फ़ॉलो-अप कब।
a.hg: Ongoing Purchase Order mein Ordered ya In transit wale har PO ki lines dikhti hain — pending quantity, delivery date aur agla follow-up kab.

en: how to make a new po
add purchase order by hand
hg: haath se purchase order kaise dale

a.en: Press + New PO, fill Supplier, mode and dates, add each line with Add SKU, Air qty / Sea qty and Add, then press Save PO.
a.hi: + New PO दबाएँ, Supplier, मोड और तारीख भरें, हर लाइन Add SKU, Air qty / Sea qty और Add से जोड़ें, फिर Save PO दबाएँ।
a.hg: + New PO dabaiye, Supplier, mode aur date bhariye, har line Add SKU, Air qty / Sea qty aur Add se jodiye, phir Save PO dabaiye.

en: my po is not showing in ongoing purchase order
saved po missing

a.en: Only POs with status Ordered or In transit are shown — open the PO and set Status to Ordered once it is really placed.
a.hi: सिर्फ़ Ordered या In transit स्टेटस वाले PO दिखते हैं — ऑर्डर सच में दे दिया हो तो PO खोलकर Status Ordered करें।
a.hg: Sirf Ordered ya In transit status wale PO dikhte hain — order sach mein de diya ho to PO kholkar Status Ordered kijiye.

en: how to log a follow up
supplier follow up note
hg: supplier se baat ka note kahan likhe

a.en: On the PO line press Log, check the Follow-up date, write what the supplier said and press Save follow-up.
a.hi: PO की लाइन पर Log दबाएँ, Follow-up date जाँचें, सप्लायर ने जो कहा लिखें और Save follow-up दबाएँ।
a.hg: PO ki line par Log dabaiye, Follow-up date check kijiye, supplier ne jo kaha likhiye aur Save follow-up dabaiye.

en: what is overdue due on track
red number on ongoing purchase order menu
hi: Overdue, Due, On track का मतलब
hg: overdue due on track ka matlab
menu par laal number kyu hai

a.en: Overdue means the delivery date has passed, Due means a follow-up is due (7 days since the order or the last follow-up), and On track means nothing to do yet.
a.hi: Overdue मतलब डिलीवरी तारीख निकल गई, Due मतलब फ़ॉलो-अप का समय हो गया (ऑर्डर या पिछले फ़ॉलो-अप से 7 दिन), और On track मतलब अभी कुछ नहीं करना।
a.hg: Overdue matlab delivery date nikal gayi, Due matlab follow-up ka time ho gaya (order ya pichhle follow-up se 7 din), aur On track matlab abhi kuch nahi karna.

en: what is pending qty
not listed red tag on po line
hg: not listed laal tag kyu hai

a.en: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock − India Stock; a red Not listed tag means the SKU is not found on Amazon and needs a listing.
a.hi: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock − India Stock; लाल Not listed टैग का मतलब SKU Amazon पर नहीं मिला, उसकी लिस्टिंग चाहिए।
a.hg: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock − India Stock; laal Not listed tag ka matlab SKU Amazon par nahi mila, uski listing chahiye.

en: how to mark po received
edit purchase order

a.en: Press Open on the PO line, change what you need (for example Status to Received, or Delivery date) and press Save PO; Delete removes the PO after you confirm.
a.hi: PO की लाइन पर Open दबाएँ, जो बदलना है बदलें (जैसे Status में Received, या Delivery date) और Save PO दबाएँ; Delete पक्का करने पर PO हटा देता है।
a.hg: PO ki line par Open dabaiye, jo badalna hai badaliye (jaise Status mein Received, ya Delivery date) aur Save PO dabaiye; Delete confirm karne par PO hata deta hai.

en: import pos from excel
export purchase orders
hg: excel se po kaise import kare

a.en: Press Export to download all POs, edit the file, then press Import; rows with a PO ID update that PO, rows without one become new POs.
a.hi: सारे PO डाउनलोड करने के लिए Export दबाएँ, फ़ाइल बदलें, फिर Import दबाएँ; जिन लाइनों में PO ID है वो उस PO को बदलेंगी, बिना ID वाली नया PO बनेंगी।
a.hg: Saare PO download karne ke liye Export dabaiye, file badaliye, phir Import dabaiye; jin lines mein PO ID hai woh us PO ko badlengi, bina ID wali naya PO banengi.

en: how is next follow-up date worked out
when does a po become due
hi: अगली फ़ॉलो-अप तारीख कैसे बनती है
hg: agli follow up date kaise banti

a.en: The next follow-up is 7 days after the last logged follow-up (or after the order date if none); Due means that day has come, and Overdue means the Delivery date has passed while the PO is still Ordered o…
a.hi: अगला फ़ॉलो-अप आखिरी दर्ज फ़ॉलो-अप के 7 दिन बाद (कोई न हो तो ऑर्डर तारीख के 7 दिन बाद) होता है; Due का मतलब वह दिन आ गया, और Overdue का मतलब Delivery date निकल गई और PO अब भी Ordered या In transit है।
a.hg: Agla follow-up aakhri darj follow-up ke 7 din baad (koi na ho to order date ke 7 din baad) hota hai; Due ka matlab woh din aa gaya, aur Overdue ka matlab Delivery date nikal gayi aur PO ab bhi Ordered ya…

en: pending qty same sku two pos
why pending is 0 though goods not arrived
hi: एक एसकेयू दो PO में तो Pending कैसे
hg: ek sku do po me to pending kaise
maal nahi aaya phir bhi pending 0 kyu

a.en: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock (Total Stock + AWD Available + AWD Transit) − India Stock, never below 0 — and it takes off ALL the stock of that SKU, not only what came from this PO, so…
a.hi: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock (Total Stock + AWD Available + AWD Transit) − India Stock, 0 से नीचे नहीं — और यह उस एसकेयू का सारा स्टॉक घटाता है, सिर्फ़ इस PO से आया नहीं, इसलिए वही स्…
a.hg: Pending Qty = Total Qty − Total FBA Stock (Total Stock + AWD Available + AWD Transit) − India Stock, 0 se neeche nahi — aur yeh us SKU ka saara stock ghatata hai, sirf is PO se aaya nahi, isliye w…

en: how does po import match rows
import without po id what happens
hi: PO Import लाइनें कैसे मिलाता है
hg: po id ke bina import karne pe kya hota

a.en: Import needs at least Supplier and SKU columns; a row with a PO ID rewrites that PO (its lines are replaced, its follow-up log kept), and rows without a PO ID become new POs, grouped by Supplier, Order D…
a.hi: Import में कम से कम Supplier और SKU कॉलम चाहिए; PO ID वाली लाइन उस PO को फिर से लिखती है (लाइनें बदल जाती हैं, फ़ॉलो-अप लॉग रहता है), और बिना PO ID की लाइनें नए PO बनती हैं, Supplier, Order Date, Deliver…
a.hg: Import mein kam se kam Supplier aur SKU column chahiye; PO ID wali line us PO ko phir se likhti hai (lines badal jati hain, follow-up log rehta hai), aur bina PO ID ki lines naye PO banti hain, Supplier,…

en: po statuses meaning draft ordered in transit received cancelled
po disappeared after setting received
hi: PO के स्टेटस का मतलब Draft Ordered In transit Received Cancelled
hg: po status ka matlab draft ordered in transit received cancelled
received karne ke baad po gayab kyu

a.en: A PO moves Draft → Ordered → In transit → Received (or Cancelled); only Ordered and In transit POs show on Ongoing Purchase Order, count in the follow-up badge, and count as "Ongoing PO" in In Production — Draft, Rece…
a.hi: PO Draft → Ordered → In transit → Received (या Cancelled) चलता है; सिर्फ़ Ordered और In transit PO Ongoing Purchase Order पर दिखते हैं, फ़ॉलो-अप बैज में गिने जाते हैं, और In Production में "Ongoing PO" बनते हैं — Draf…
a.hg: PO Draft → Ordered → In transit → Received (ya Cancelled) chalta hai; sirf Ordered aur In transit PO Ongoing Purchase Order par dikhte hain, follow-up badge mein gine jate hain, aur In Production mein "Ongoing PO" ban…

en: how to delete a purchase order
delete PO

a.en: On Ongoing Purchase Order press Open on any line of that PO, then press Delete and confirm — the whole PO, with all its lines and follow-ups, is removed.
a.hi: Ongoing Purchase Order पर उस PO की किसी भी पंक्ति में Open दबाएँ, फिर Delete दबाकर पुष्टि करें — पूरा PO, उसकी सारी lines और follow-ups के साथ, हट जाता है।
a.hg: Ongoing Purchase Order par us PO ki kisi bhi line mein Open dabaiye, phir Delete daba kar confirm kijiye — poora PO, uski saari lines aur follow-ups ke saath, hat jaata hai.

title.en: Log a follow-up on a purchase order
title.hi: Purchase order पर follow-up दर्ज करना
title.hg: Purchase order par follow-up record karna

steps.en: Let's note down what the supplier said about a PO.
steps.hi: चलिए PO के बारे में supplier ने जो कहा वो दर्ज करते हैं।
steps.hg: Chaliye PO ke baare mein supplier ne jo kaha wo record karte hain.

steps.en: Find the PO: type a SKU in Filter SKU, or pick it in All PO IDs or All suppliers.
steps.hi: PO ढूँढें: Filter SKU में SKU लिखें, या All PO IDs / All suppliers से चुनें।
steps.hg: PO dhoondhiye: Filter SKU mein SKU likhiye, ya All PO IDs / All suppliers se chuniye.

steps.en: On the PO's line, press Log.
steps.hi: PO की लाइन पर Log दबाएँ।
steps.hg: PO ki line par Log dabaiye.

steps.en: The Follow-up date is today. Change it only if you spoke on another day — Next follow-up moves with it.
steps.hi: Follow-up date में आज की तारीख है। किसी और दिन बात हुई हो तभी बदलें — Next follow-up साथ में बदलता है।
steps.hg: Follow-up date mein aaj ki date hai. Kisi aur din baat hui ho tabhi badliye — Next follow-up saath mein badalta hai.

steps.en: Write what the supplier said — e.g. "dispatched, ETA revised to …".
steps.hi: Supplier ने जो कहा वो लिखें — जैसे "dispatched, ETA revised to …"।
steps.hg: Supplier ne jo kaha wo likhiye — jaise "dispatched, ETA revised to …".

steps.en: Press Save follow-up. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Save follow-up दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save follow-up dabaiye. Ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — it says Follow-up saved. and the line's next follow-up date has moved. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — Follow-up saved. लिखा आता है और लाइन की अगली follow-up तारीख आगे हो जाती है। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — Follow-up saved. likha aata hai aur line ki agli follow-up date aage ho jaati hai. 🎉

title.en: Import purchase orders from a file
title.hi: फ़ाइल से purchase orders इम्पोर्ट करना
title.hg: File se purchase orders import karna

steps.en: Let's bring purchase orders in from a file. A row with a PO ID replaces that PO's lines; a row without one makes a new PO.
steps.hi: चलिए फ़ाइल से purchase orders लाते हैं। PO ID वाली लाइन उस PO की lines बदल देती है; बिना PO ID वाली से नया PO बनता है।
steps.hg: Chaliye file se purchase orders laate hain. PO ID wali line us PO ki lines badal deti hai; bina PO ID wali se naya PO banta hai.

steps.en: Best start: press Export to download every PO, edit that file in Excel and keep the headings as they are. It needs at least Supplier and SKU.
steps.hi: सबसे अच्छा: Export दबाकर सारे PO डाउनलोड करें, उसी फ़ाइल को Excel में बदलें और हेडिंग न बदलें। कम से कम Supplier और SKU चाहिए।
steps.hg: Sabse achha: Export daba kar saare PO download kijiye, usi file ko Excel mein badliye aur headings mat badliye. Kam se kam Supplier aur SKU chahiye.

steps.en: Press Import, choose the file, then press OK on the question. That OK saves it for real.
steps.hi: Import दबाएँ, फ़ाइल चुनें, फिर सवाल पर OK दबाएँ। OK दबाते ही यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Import dabaiye, file chuniye, phir sawaal par OK dabaiye. OK dabate hi ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: It says Imported n PO(s). when done. If it says CSV needs at least "Supplier" and "SKU" columns, fix the headings in the file and import again.
steps.hi: पूरा होने पर Imported n PO(s). लिखा आता है। CSV needs at least "Supplier" and "SKU" columns आए तो फ़ाइल की हेडिंग ठीक करके फिर इम्पोर्ट करें।
steps.hg: Poora hone par Imported n PO(s). likha aata hai. CSV needs at least "Supplier" and "SKU" columns aaye to file ki headings theek karke phir import kijiye.

steps.en: Let's make a new purchase order. I'll light each box — fill it and I move on.
steps.hi: चलिए नया purchase order बनाते हैं। मैं हर बॉक्स दिखाऊँगी — भरते ही आगे बढ़ूँगी।
steps.hg: Chaliye naya purchase order banate hain. Main har box dikhaungi — bharte hi aage badhungi.

steps.en: Press + New PO.
steps.hi: + New PO दबाएँ।
steps.hg: + New PO dabaiye.

steps.en: Check the Brand — Ridhi or CPC.
steps.hi: Brand चेक करें — Ridhi या CPC।
steps.hg: Brand check kijiye — Ridhi ya CPC.

steps.en: Type the Supplier name.
steps.hi: Supplier का नाम लिखें।
steps.hg: Supplier ka naam likhiye.

steps.en: Pick the Mode — Sea or Air.
steps.hi: Mode चुनें — Sea या Air।
steps.hg: Mode chuniye — Sea ya Air.

steps.en: The Order date is today. Change it only if you ordered on another day.
steps.hi: Order date में आज की तारीख है। किसी और दिन ऑर्डर किया हो तभी बदलें।
steps.hg: Order date mein aaj ki date hai. Kisi aur din order kiya ho tabhi badliye.

steps.en: Pick the Delivery date the supplier promised.
steps.hi: Supplier ने जो Delivery date बताई वो चुनें।
steps.hg: Supplier ne jo Delivery date batayi wo chuniye.

steps.en: Set Status. Only Ordered and In transit POs show on this screen — leave Draft if it is not ordered yet.
steps.hi: Status चुनें। इस स्क्रीन पर सिर्फ़ Ordered और In transit PO दिखते हैं — अभी ऑर्डर नहीं हुआ तो Draft रहने दें।
steps.hg: Status chuniye. Is screen par sirf Ordered aur In transit PO dikhte hain — abhi order nahi hua to Draft rehne dijiye.

steps.en: Type the first SKU in Add SKU.
steps.hi: Add SKU में पहला SKU लिखें।
steps.hg: Add SKU mein pehla SKU likhiye.

steps.en: Type the Air qty and/or the Sea qty beside it — at least one above 0.
steps.hi: Air qty और/या उसके पास Sea qty लिखें — कम से कम एक 0 से ज़्यादा।
steps.hg: Air qty aur/ya uske paas Sea qty likhiye — kam se kam ek 0 se zyada.

steps.en: Press Add. The line appears above. Do the same for every SKU.
steps.hi: Add दबाएँ। लाइन ऊपर आ जाएगी। हर SKU के लिए ऐसे ही करें।
steps.hg: Add dabaiye. Line upar aa jayegi. Har SKU ke liye aise hi kijiye.

steps.en: A Note is optional.
steps.hi: Note ज़रूरी नहीं है।
steps.hg: Note zaroori nahi hai.

steps.en: Check it all, then press Save PO. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: सब चेक करें, फिर Save PO दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Sab check kijiye, phir Save PO dabaiye. Ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — if its Status is Ordered or In transit, the PO's lines are in this list now. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — Status Ordered या In transit है तो PO की lines अब इस लिस्ट में हैं। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — Status Ordered ya In transit hai to PO ki lines ab is list mein hain. 🎉

steps.en: Find the PO: type a SKU in Filter SKU, or pick it in All PO IDs.
steps.hi: PO ढूँढें: Filter SKU में SKU लिखें, या All PO IDs से चुनें।
steps.hg: PO dhoondhiye: Filter SKU mein SKU likhiye, ya All PO IDs se chuniye.

steps.en: Press Open on any line of that PO.
steps.hi: उस PO की किसी भी लाइन पर Open दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Us PO ki kisi bhi line par Open dabaiye.

steps.en: Change what you need — for example Status to Received when the goods have come.
steps.hi: जो बदलना है बदलें — जैसे माल आ गया तो Status को Received करें।
steps.hg: Jo badalna hai badliye — jaise maal aa gaya to Status ko Received kijiye.

steps.en: Or move the Delivery date if the supplier gave a new one.
steps.hi: या supplier ने नई तारीख दी हो तो Delivery date बदलें।
steps.hg: Ya supplier ne nayi date di ho to Delivery date badliye.

steps.en: To drop one SKU press ✕ on its line; to add one, use Add SKU below.
steps.hi: एक SKU हटाना हो तो उसकी लाइन पर ✕ दबाएँ; जोड़ना हो तो नीचे Add SKU से जोड़ें।
steps.hg: Ek SKU hatana ho to uski line par ✕ dabaiye; jodna ho to neeche Add SKU se jodiye.

steps.en: Press Save PO. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Save PO दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save PO dabaiye. Ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — the list shows the change. A PO set to Received or Cancelled leaves this list. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — लिस्ट में बदलाव दिख रहा है। Received या Cancelled किया PO इस लिस्ट से हट जाता है। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — list mein badlav dikh raha hai. Received ya Cancelled kiya PO is list se hat jaata hai. 🎉

steps.en: Delete takes the whole PO — all its lines and follow-ups. To drop only one SKU, open the PO and press ✕ on that line instead.
steps.hi: Delete पूरा PO हटाता है — सारी lines और follow-ups के साथ। सिर्फ़ एक SKU हटाना हो तो PO खोलकर उस लाइन पर ✕ दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Delete poora PO hatata hai — saari lines aur follow-ups ke saath. Sirf ek SKU hatana ho to PO khol kar us line par ✕ dabaiye.

steps.en: Find the PO: type a SKU in Filter SKU, or pick it in All PO IDs.
steps.hi: PO ढूँढें: Filter SKU में SKU लिखें, या All PO IDs से चुनें।
steps.hg: PO dhoondhiye: Filter SKU mein SKU likhiye, ya All PO IDs se chuniye.

steps.en: Press Open on any line of that PO.
steps.hi: उस PO की किसी भी लाइन पर Open दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Us PO ki kisi bhi line par Open dabaiye.

steps.en: Check the supplier and the lines — this is the PO that will go.
steps.hi: Supplier और lines चेक करें — यही PO हटेगा।
steps.hg: Supplier aur lines check kijiye — yahi PO hatega.

steps.en: Press Delete, then OK. This deletes it for real.
steps.hi: Delete दबाएँ, फिर OK। यह असली में मिट जाता है।
steps.hg: Delete dabaiye, phir OK. Ye asli mein delete ho jaata hai.

steps.en: Done — the PO is gone from this list. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — PO इस लिस्ट से हट गया। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — PO is list se hat gaya. 🎉

title.en: Make a PO from the Replenishment view

steps.en: Let's turn what Replenishment says is needed into a purchase order. India stock and pieces already in production are taken off for you.
steps.hi: चलिए Replenishment जो ज़रूरत बताता है उससे purchase order बनाते हैं। India stock और production में चल रहे पीस अपने आप घट जाते हैं।
steps.hg: Chaliye Replenishment jo zaroorat batata hai usse purchase order banate hain. India stock aur production mein chal rahe piece apne aap ghat jaate hain.

steps.en: Pick one brand — a PO is for one brand.
steps.hi: एक brand चुनें — एक PO एक ही brand का होता है।
steps.hg: Ek brand chuniye — ek PO ek hi brand ka hota hai.

steps.en: Narrow the list to the SKUs you want to order — type in Filter SKU / ASIN / product or use the drop-downs. Only what is on screen goes in.
steps.hi: जिन SKU का ऑर्डर देना है सिर्फ़ वो दिखाएँ — Filter SKU / ASIN / product में लिखें या ड्रॉपडाउन लगाएँ। स्क्रीन पर जो है वही PO में जाएगा।
steps.hg: Jin SKU ka order dena hai sirf wo dikhaiye — Filter SKU / ASIN / product mein likhiye ya dropdown lagaiye. Screen par jo hai wahi PO mein jayega.

steps.en: Press Create PO from view.
steps.hi: Create PO from view दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Create PO from view dabaiye.

steps.en: These lines are what is still needed; the small "−" note says what India stock or production took off. Press ✕ on any line you do not want.
steps.hi: ये lines वो हैं जो अभी भी चाहिए; छोटा "−" नोट बताता है India stock या production से कितना घटा। जो लाइन नहीं चाहिए उस पर ✕ दबाएँ।
steps.hg: Ye lines wo hain jo abhi bhi chahiye; chhota "−" note batata hai India stock ya production se kitna ghata. Jo line nahi chahiye us par ✕ dabaiye.

steps.en: Type the Supplier name.
steps.hi: Supplier का नाम लिखें।
steps.hg: Supplier ka naam likhiye.

steps.en: Pick the Delivery date.
steps.hi: Delivery date चुनें।
steps.hg: Delivery date chuniye.

steps.en: Set Status to Ordered once it is really ordered — only then does it show on Ongoing Purchase Order.
steps.hi: सच में ऑर्डर हो जाए तो Status को Ordered करें — तभी यह Ongoing Purchase Order पर दिखेगा।
steps.hg: Sach mein order ho jaye to Status ko Ordered kijiye — tabhi ye Ongoing Purchase Order par dikhega.

steps.en: Press Save PO. This saves it for real.
steps.hi: Save PO दबाएँ। यह असली में सेव होता है।
steps.hg: Save PO dabaiye. Ye asli mein save hota hai.

steps.en: Done — with Status Ordered or In transit, the PO is here on Ongoing Purchase Order. 🎉
steps.hi: हो गया — Status Ordered या In transit है तो PO यहाँ Ongoing Purchase Order पर है। 🎉
steps.hg: Ho gaya — Status Ordered ya In transit hai to PO yahan Ongoing Purchase Order par hai. 🎉
